scope: Opt-in Compose and profile-planner source acceptance for self-hosted ZITADEL.

database owner is the dedicated zitadel role

Caddy routes Login V2 and proxies the API over h2c with TE removed.
Versioned API and Login image tags are used instead of latest.

OCI digest and multi-architecture manifest verification remain open.
